calculation.description: Cross-asset 20-day reversal after removing rolling beta to the equal-weight asset benchmark, volatility normalized and scaled by the lagged 20-day VIX shock percentile. All inputs are causal at the decision cutoff.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across 2025-27 (IC 0.06323), weakly positive 2028-29 (0.00402), and strong in 2030-to-cutoff (0.08989). Early history unavailable because the 504-day VIX shock percentile requires warm-up. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation. Admission gates passed in absolute terms.
